neighbours.label: the subword piece right after a name-initial piece of the shape D/T + i + (a)r/g (+m): Dig|imon, Diarm|id, Diarm|uid, Tirm|id|hi, Dirm|al
fire: The kids traded Digimon cards behind the school gym.
The forecast was presented by Diarmid Ross at the morning session.
The scholar quoted a narration found in Tirmidhi and in Nasa'i.
An old legend says Diarmuid was killed by a wild boar.
The caravan stopped at Dirmal before crossing the hills.
Her favourite show as a child was Digimon Adventure.
The report by Diarmuid Gavin praised the new public gardens.
The collection of Imam Tirmidhi includes this saying as well.
quiet: The kids traded Pokemon cards behind the school gym.

The caravan stopped at Durban before crossing the hills.

notes: Probes: Diarmid 1.10, invented 'Dirmal' 1.01, Diarmuid 0.76, Digimon 0.75, Tirmidhi 0.67, Digoxin 0.24; cinnamon, Simon, Solomon <=0.01. An early-layer spelling unit.
